_about: Narration for the Spend Radar demo film (v3: the papery cartoon world, comp/comp.js). `say` is what the voice reads (spelled for pronunciation); `cap` is the on-screen caption; `big` lines are drawn as huge kinetic type. `exag` = expressiveness for that line. Every number comes from the evidence named in `src`.

lines.say: Your competitor just doubled their em ell team!
lines.cap: Your competitor just doubled their ML team!

lines.say: And you'll find out... next quarter.
lines.cap: And you'll find out… next quarter.

lines.say: Unless your agent finds out first!
lines.cap: Unless your agent finds out first!

lines.say: Meet Spend Radar! It reads your books, checks the market, and then tries to prove itself wrong.
lines.cap: Meet Spend Radar! It reads your books, checks the market — then tries to prove itself wrong.

lines.say: Let's watch a real run!
lines.cap: Let's watch a real run!

lines.say: The model writes the plan. Then it's one tool call at a time.
lines.cap: The model writes the plan. Then: one tool call at a time.

lines.say: Budget, invoices, policy, then real headcount from Crust-data.
lines.cap: Budget, invoices, policy — then real headcount from Crustdata.

lines.say: Python checks all seventy-one results. Uh oh, a budget row doesn't add up!
lines.cap: Python checks all 71 results. Uh-oh — a budget row doesn't add up!

lines.say: The rule says, mark it low confidence. The model says, re-read that row!
lines.cap: Rule: mark it low confidence. Model: re-read that row!

lines.say: Scanned PDF? Read it another way. Corrupt PDF? Flag it and move on.
lines.cap: Scanned PDF? Read it another way. Corrupt PDF? Flag it, move on.
lines.src: decisions t15 reparse_alt; t16/t16r reparse_alt, skip; not_analysed

lines.say: Five of its ten recovery calls beat the rule!
lines.cap: 5 of its 10 recovery calls beat the rule!

lines.say: And now, the best part.
lines.cap: And now… the best part.

lines.say: It flagged a five point two eight million dollar gap in Acme's em ell team.
lines.cap: It flagged a $5.28M gap in Acme's ML team.

lines.say: Then it argued with itself, and overturned it!
lines.cap: Then it argued with itself — and overturned it!

lines.say: Wrong claims never reach the report.
lines.cap: Wrong claims never reach the report.

lines.say: Seven companies. Six it had never seen before.
lines.cap: 7 companies. 6 it had never seen before.

lines.say: Every planted error, caught. Zero false alarms!
lines.cap: Every planted error caught. Zero false alarms!

lines.say: We debugged all of it in neet logs.
lines.cap: We debugged all of it in neatlogs.

lines.say: One trace caught it dumping three of five competitors. The fix kept all five, and cut credits from twenty-six point six to five point four!
lines.cap: One trace: 3 of 5 competitors dumped. The fix: all 5 kept, credits 26.6 → 5.4!

lines.say: Same data, three different verdicts? Now, just one.
lines.cap: Same data, 3 different verdicts? Now: just 1.

lines.say: Entire gave our coding agent a memory. Sixty-nine checkpoints!
lines.cap: Entire gave our coding agent a memory: 69 checkpoints!

lines.say: Click any trace, and follow it back to the code, the commit, and the prompt that wrote it.
lines.cap: Click any trace → the code → the commit → the prompt that wrote it.

lines.say: Its review runners even caught two bugs before merge!
lines.cap: Its review runners even caught 2 bugs before merge!

lines.say: And CFO dot AI built the business plan from our real costs.
lines.cap: And cfo.ai built the business plan from our real costs.

lines.say: Under three cents of AI per run. Competitor data is ninety-nine percent of the cost.
lines.cap: Under 3¢ of AI per run. Competitor data: ~99% of the cost.
